## Checklist

- [ ] The change is focused and linked to an issue when it materially changes behavior or evaluation.
- [ ] I added or updated tests, or explained why no test applies.
- [ ] `npm test` passes locally, and the result is included above.
- [ ] Fixtures, logs, screenshots, and evaluation inputs use synthetic, non-identifying data only.
- [ ] I did not include confidential contents or unpatched vulnerability details.
- [ ] User-visible changes include relevant documentation and `CHANGELOG.md` updates.
- [ ] Evaluation claims include dataset/ruleset versions, engine version or commit, command, raw result, and relevant environment details.
- [ ] Citation and audit-field contracts remain intact, or their revision is documented and tested.
- [ ] I stated known limitations and did not present roadmap work as implemented.

## Risk and rollback

Describe compatibility, privacy, audit, or performance risks and the smallest rollback procedure.
